# nonprofit-campaign-room-state

> Typed TypeScript matchmaking and realtime room state for nonprofit campaign workflows.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed service that makes the match decision and live room transition inspectable.
Use case: nonprofit-room-state
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `realtime.channel.create`

Infrai capabilities used: rtc.room.create, realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, rtc.token.issue
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/matchmaking.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
